source_snapshot.items: Full Mirror primary UCE plus secondary CE
source_snapshot.procedure: Arm secondary CE and primary UCE at the same0x100000000 line without immediate consumption; verify roles; write cafecafe pattern, wbinvd, verify injectors unarmed, read to consume; inspect primary B2CMI and secondary IMC/retry; go.
source_snapshot.criteria: Dual-channel injection and source registers match.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic logs omit injector roles and dual-bank evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores two-channel arm/writeback/read causality and exact fields.

old_problem: Primary/secondary mapping, deferred injector-role semantics, the destructive pattern/writeback/read trigger, dual-bank decoder and crash recovery require project approval.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection and Recovery. This is a coordinated same-line dual-copy fault: generic logs cannot prove which injector armed which channel, that both were consumed by the intended writeback/read, or that primary B2CMI and secondary IMC/retry evidence correspond to one event.
decision_basis: Preserved deferred arm roles, exact address, cafecafe write, wbinvd/read, unarmed checks, dual-bank registers and go.
Kept same-line UCE+CE coverage distinct from one-sided UCE and persistent failover.
No memory write, cache flush, injection or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GNR Full-Mirror same-line primary UCE plus secondary CE
test_case.purpose: Prove mirrored data remains correct when one cache line has a primary UCE and secondary CE, with both sides attributed to their intended banks.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/ITP and deferred Inj2ndCh semantics
Verified primary MC0/ch0 and secondary MC1 mapping for0x100000000
Authorized sacrificial line and cafecafe/wbinvd/read procedure
Primary B2CMI plus secondary IMC/retry decoder
Dedicated SUT, OOB recovery and injector cleanup
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies target and clean baseline, arms the secondary CE and primary UCE without consumption, proves injector roles, writes the approved pattern, executes wbinvd, confirms injectors unarmed, performs one read, captures primary B2CMI and secondary IMC/retry evidence, executes go once, verifies data/health and restores state.
test_case.expected_result: Both faults are consumed at the intended same line; mirrored data is delivered correctly, primary B2CMI and secondary corrected-read/retry fields match the approved oracle, and resume/restoration succeed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact two-side mapping/roles, single authorized trigger chain, both decoded banks, correct returned data, healthy go and cleanup. Wrong side, premature consumption, data mismatch, fatal escape or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT and approved sacrificial address/data overwrite.
Verify both deferred injector roles before any write or flush.
Stop on premature arm consumption or unexpected severity.
No automatic retry, added read/write, reboot or reinjection.
expected_evidence: Both deferred arm transcripts and pre-trigger state
Primary B2CMI and secondary IMC/retry correlation
Returned data, post-go health and restoration
test_case.recovery: On wrong role, data corruption, fatal event or hang, preserve evidence, use approved OOB recovery and clear injectors through vendor procedure before reboot; restore the sacrificial data/state and mirror settings.

source_conflict.reason: The two armed faults, common trigger line and dual-bank evidence consistently describe one mirrored-line resilience test.

blocked.reason: Target, ITP semantics, oracle and recovery are supplyable critical prerequisites.
